title: Architecture boundary ResolvedPaths migration
summary: Migrated the ResolvedPaths record family to mediapipeline.core.paths.contracts, updated core/tool imports to the domain-owned home, preserved desktop and kernel compatibility exports, adjusted the Phase 0 ratchet for symbol-subset debt reductions, refreshed generated summaries, and removed the checker-reported stale allowlist entries.
reason: Start Phase 2 by moving the high-fanout path state record to its actual domain owner so later Queue, Completed, Audit, Failure, Snapshot, Telemetry, and Config record slices do not keep carrying ResolvedPaths through desktop model containers.
behavior_before: Core services imported ResolvedPaths through mediapipeline.desktop.models, mediapipeline.desktop.models_core, or transitional kernel model containers, keeping many NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP allowlist entries alive.
behavior_after: Core services and tooling import ResolvedPaths from mediapipeline.core.paths.contracts. Legacy desktop and kernel model paths still resolve to the same class object. JSON/state-file paths, Local API payload fields, command names, WebView contracts, media policy, publish/drain, rename, and source/scratch/output behavior are unchanged.
